stem_book: If sin(x − y) = cos(x + y) = 1/2, then the values of x and y lying between 0° to 180° are (a) x = 45°, y = 15° (b) x = 45°, y = 135° (c) x = 165°, y = 15° (d) x = 165°, y = 135°
reason: Key gives only (a), but (d) also satisfies: x − y = 30° ⇒ sin = 1/2, x + y = 300° ⇒ cos = 1/2. Option (c) printed 'y = 165°, y = 15°' corrected to x = 165° (still wrong: cos 180° = −1).
